hero.title: Curated pours *and bottles to take home*
hero.lede: A downtown Aiken wine shop and bar on Horry Street. Marchand de vin is French for wine merchant: come for a glass, a weekly mystery-wine tasting or live music on Saturdays, and leave with a bottle.

items.text: Wine by the glass in a small downtown parlor.

items.title: The mystery-wine tasting
items.text: Once a week the owners pour everyone a small sip, then quiz the room on what's in the glass.

sections.title: Four owners, *one wine shop*
body: Solo Vino / Marchand de Vin is owned by two couples: Marold and Kristin Kamai and Greg and Lori Cefus. At the weekly mystery-wine tasting you'll find them circulating through the crowd, pouring small sips and asking what you taste.
The shop shares its address with The BackYard restaurant, which charges no corkage when you bring a bottle bought next door at Solo Vino.
list: Glasses to sip, bottles to take home
No corkage at The BackYard next door

items.q: Can I drink a bottle from Solo Vino with dinner next door?
items.a: Yes. The BackYard, at the same address, charges no corkage on wine bought from Solo Vino.
Saturday evenings from 6 to 8 pm, as listed by Visit Aiken. Call to check this week's line-up.

items.q: How does the mystery-wine tasting work?
items.a: The owners pour everyone a small sip of the same wine, then quiz the group about it. Call for this week's day and time.

sections.text: Live music from 6 to 8 pm on Horry Street.
